# ReportBeacon

> Custom internal reporting systems for marketing agencies. Most agencies do
> not lack data — they lack one place to see it. Pulls the ad platforms, CRM and
> internal data an agency runs into a single view the team works from, carrying
> the agency's own branding, with client reports built from the same numbers and
> sent on a schedule. Not a dashboard product: a system, built per agency.

Site: https://demo.tinashebenson.com/
Live demo: https://demo.tinashebenson.com/app — opens directly, no signup, no
email, no login. Runs on sample data; nothing a visitor does is saved.
Built by: Tinashe Benson — https://www.tinashebenson.com

## Who it is for

Marketing, PPC and SEO agencies running roughly 10–50 client accounts. The
buyer is normally the agency owner or founder, because the thing being sold
touches both client-facing work and agency margin.

## The problem it addresses

Most agencies report through Looker Studio because it is free, then meet its
limits:

- It is native to Google and nothing else, so every non-Google platform needs a
  paid third-party connector, billed monthly and per platform.
- It puts a vendor footer on a report the agency is charging a client for.
- Nothing sends itself; someone has to remember.
- Every new client means building, then maintaining, another report by hand.

The result is that the first week of every month disappears into exports and
rebuilt slide decks — work nobody scoped and everybody pays for.

## What it does

- The whole client roster on one screen: health, leads, cost per lead, and how
  spend is pacing against budget.
- Surfaces problems before the client calls: a dropped lead source, a response
  time slipping past target, spend running ahead of budget.
- Budget recommendations with the arithmetic shown. Can use a built-in engine or
  a model connected through OpenRouter.
- Client-ready reports in one click, on the real reporting dates.
- Scheduled delivery, weekly or monthly, per client, automatic.
- Role-based access: the agency owner sees margin, account managers see their
  accounts without it, clients get a read-only view scoped to them.
- White label throughout — console, reports, scheduled email and the client
  login all carry the agency, with no vendor mark.

## Platforms

Built to sit on Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Business
Profile, SEMrush, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads and Local Services Ads, plus
whatever else an agency reports on. The platform list is scoped per build.

## Compared with Looker Studio

| | Looker Studio | ReportBeacon |
|---|---|---|
| Non-Google platforms | Third-party connectors, billed monthly | Built into your instance |
| Your branding | Vendor footer on every report | Your logo, colours and domain |
| Adding a client | Rebuild and maintain a new report | Add the account |
| Sending the report | Someone remembers to do it | Weekly or monthly, on its own |
| Client access | Share a link and hope | Read-only seat, scoped to them |
| Margin | Same view for everyone | Owner sees it, account managers do not |

## Pricing

A custom-built internal system, not a SaaS subscription.

- **Foundation — $4,000 to $7,000, one-off.** For agencies at roughly 5–25
  staff. Platforms connected and syncing, one view across the whole roster,
  role-based access for the team, scheduled client reports. Yours to keep.
- **Intelligence — $8,000 to $15,000, one-off.** For agencies at roughly 15–50
  staff. Everything in Foundation, plus manual reporting removed end to end, an
  AI insight layer, deeper integrations including CRM and internal data, and
  client-facing shareable views.
- **Full system — custom, typically from $18,000.** Larger rosters and
  multi-brand groups: multiple brands, offices or regions, bespoke data sources,
  an AI interface for querying the data directly, white-label domain and client
  logins.

Optional ongoing, neither required: support $400–$1,200/month, optimisation
$1,200–$2,500/month.

Every build is scoped on a call before anything starts, and the work is staged
so the buyer sees it running rather than paying up front for a promise. A
limited number of design-partner places exist at a reduced rate for smaller
agencies, by application rather than as a published price.

## Honest limitations

- The public demo runs entirely on sample data. Every figure in it is invented
  so the console can be explored without connecting any account. It is a
  demonstration of how the product works, not a record of any real agency.
- It is sold as a build, not as an off-the-shelf subscription product. What a
  given agency ends up with is scoped on a call.
- It is built by one person rather than a company with a support desk, which is
  why engagements are staged rather than paid up front.
